name: MQT Bench networks

source.version: MQT Bench v1.1.9 pre-generated archive (files generated with MQT Bench 1.1.0 and Qiskit 1.0.2)

circuit_selection.rule: families at every qubit count: files whose qubit count is on qubit_grid; families at fixed sizes: all files. Only file names are used.

preprocessing.parser: quimb 1.15.0 Circuit.from_openqasm2_str after removing final measurements, barriers and classical registers
preprocessing.non_unitary: files with a reset, or with a measurement followed by a gate on the same qubit, are excluded
preprocessing.zero_value_handling: if norm equalization divides by zero (the task value is exactly zero), the network is rebuilt without it
preprocessing.unsupported_gate_definitions: rzz, rxx and ch are written as exact decompositions; rccx uses its qelib1.inc definition

expectation_z.definition: <0^n| C^dag Z_c C |0^n>, c = floor((n-1)/2), reverse light cone only

expectation_zz.definition: <0^n| C^dag Z_c Z_(c+1) C |0^n>, c = floor((n-1)/2), reverse light cone only

state.definition: all qubits open for n <= 28; otherwise qubits round(i (n-1) / 19), i = 0..19, open and the others fixed to |0>

planned_networks: networks with 3 to 4999 tensors after simplification; at most two tensors need no search, 5000 or more are not planned
